start: Owner of a gym with 2 or more branches, online, any panel page

steps.action: At the top of the panel open the Branch list and pick "All branches"
user_sees: Page title "All branches" with "<business name> · <n> branches"
"Loading every branch…" while the other branches are read
must_not: Only the open branch's numbers in the totals without a word
The page switches the open branch

steps.action: Read the six tiles and the "Each branch" card
user_sees: Tiles "Active members", "Money in this month" (with "₹… today"), "Fees due" ("<n> people owe"), "Came in today", "Plans ending in 7 days", "Joined this month"

"Can train at every branch" for an all-branch member

steps.action: Tap "Open" on one member of another branch
